pricing.rule: Each delivered call bills price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005. A pending/async ack or an unverifiable charged call (delivered:false, refundable:false) bills price_usd × 1.15 with no per-call fee; refunded calls, in-batch duplicates and failed runs bill $0. A call runs only when its full delivered amount fits the batch's remaining max_usd, so max_usd must be at least Σ(price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005).

updates.content:
😭💀 $LEOSTAR really pulled a GTA move on everybody!

Chart was cruising around $1M–$1.5M market cap, started climbing, then BOOM! 💥 Somebody hit the eject button! 📉🤣

From around $1.6M to just $2.8K, down 99.8%! 💀

📚 Lesson: Just because a chart is making higher highs doesn’t mean it’s safe. One massive sell-off can erase the whole party. Watch liquidity, big wallets, and selling pressure before jumping in.

Moral of the story: Don’t be the last passenger on a rocket that’s already missing its engine. 🚀😭

callout.thesis: LEOSTAR — GTA 6 launches Nov 19 in Leonida, and the official Leonida map drops on launch day. Called at $984K. RugCheck shows no danger risks. Linked wallets hold about 0% of supply. We hold a small position, about $1.
